description: Converts Markdown into formal PDF and Word documents. Supports a cover page, table of contents, page numbers, page borders, a confidentiality stamp and protection (edit restriction / digital signature), and never modifies the Markdown source.
configuration.markdownFormal.page.title: 1. Paper and page border
markdownFormal.page.format.enum.A3: A3 (297 x 420 mm) for large diagrams and tables
markdownFormal.page.format.enum.Letter: Letter (216 x 279 mm) for North America
markdownFormal.page.format.enum.Legal: Legal (216 x 356 mm) for North American contracts
markdownFormal.page.orientation.descript: Paper orientation. Applies to the whole document.
markdownFormal.page.margin.description: Margin, written in CSS notation (for example 18mm or 20mm 15mm).
markdownFormal.frame.body.description: Draw a page border on the body pages.
markdownFormal.frame.toc.description: Draw a page border on the table of contents.
markdownFormal.frame.cover.description: Draw a page border on the cover.
markdownFormal.frame.color.description: Colour of the page border line.
markdownFormal.frame.width.description: Thickness of the page border line.
markdownFormal.frame.padding.description: Gap between the page border and the text.
configuration.markdownFormal.style.title: 2. Fonts and headings
markdownFormal.font.body.description: Body font. List fallbacks so that it resolves on all three operating systems.
markdownFormal.heading.style.enum.band: Heading 1 reversed out of a band; heading 2 with a bottom rule
markdownFormal.heading.style.enum.underl: Bottom rule on both heading 1 and heading 2
markdownFormal.heading.accentColor.descr: Colour of the band behind heading 1.
markdownFormal.heading.pageBreakLevel.de: Break the page before headings up to this level. Set 0 to never break.
markdownFormal.cover.enabled.description: Generate a cover page from the front matter.
markdownFormal.stamp.rotate.description: Tilt of the confidentiality stamp, in degrees. PDF only; Word does not tilt it.
markdownFormal.toc.enabled.description: Generate a table of contents page. The Markdown source is not modified.
markdownFormal.toc.depth.description: Heading levels listed in the table of contents.
markdownFormal.toc.title.description: Heading of the table of contents page.
markdownFormal.pageNumber.enabled.descri: Show page numbers on the body pages. The cover and contents pages get none.
markdownFormal.protection.mode.descripti: PDF protection mode. Restrict and sign cannot be combined.
markdownFormal.protection.mode.enum.rest: Edit restriction (permissions password). Viewers honour it voluntarily, so it does not prevent tampering
markdownFormal.protection.mode.enum.sign: Digital signature (tamper detection). Requires a certificate and cannot be combined with the edit restriction
markdownFormal.protection.permissions.pr: Printing permission, used with the edit restriction.
Allow low resolution only (discourages redistribution of the original)
markdownFormal.protection.permissions.co: Allow text to be copied, used with the edit restriction.
markdownFormal.protection.permissions.an: Allow annotations to be added, used with the edit restriction.
markdownFormal.signing.certificatePath.d: Absolute path to the signing certificate (.p12 / .pfx). Keep it outside the repository. The passphrase is stored in SecretStorage from a command.
markdownFormal.hash.emit.description: Write a SHA-256 fingerprint file (.sha256) alongside the output, for checking against the document register.
markdownFormal.outputDirectory.descripti: Output directory. Leave empty to write next to the Markdown file.
markdownFormal.browser.executablePath.de: Path to the Chrome or Edge executable. Leave empty to detect it automatically.
markdownFormal.customCss.description: Absolute path to an extra CSS file. It overrides the default styles (PDF only).
command.markdownFormal.exportPdf.title: Convert to PDF
command.markdownFormal.exportDocx.title: Convert to Word (docx)
command.markdownFormal.exportBoth.title: Convert to both PDF and Word
command.markdownFormal.verifyPdf.title: Verify a PDF (fingerprint / protection state)
submenu.markdownFormal.submenu.label: Convert with Markdown Formal
